title: External execution: plan and imported results
description: The non-automated branch of a run (task group 7.2): approved manual, component and skip cases. Three documents share this schema, told apart by `document`. The IMPORT (the normalized JSON handed to scripts/import-execution.js --from) is described below. The PLAN (planner-input/[story-id].external-plan.json, written by the Test Designer) states for each case how it is executed and what evidence is required; a human reviews it at external_plan_reviewed before any external work. The RESULTS (external-evidence/[story-id].results.json, written only by scripts/import-execution.js) record what the operator reports, with evidence digests; importing asserts nothing about review — external_evidence_reviewed records that separately. Skip cases are never executed and never have a result.

import.description: The normalized JSON a component suite (or an operator) hands to scripts/import-execution.js --from: what was run and what came out, with evidence paths. The import checks every entry against the reviewed plan and writes the RESULTS document; this file itself is never evidence of review. Component output of any other format is converted to this outside the pipeline.

evidence.description: Repository-relative paths; the import digests them.

source.description: manual: a person follows the procedure. component: an external command (a component suite) is run outside this pipeline and its normalized result imported. skip: approved exclusion, never executed.

procedure.description: manual: the steps the operator follows.

command.description: component: the external command that produces the result (run outside this pipeline).

expected_outcome.description: What a pass means, from the case's expected_results.

evidence_required.description: What must be attached to a result (e.g. a screenshot of the confirmation page, the component suite's JSON output).

exclusion_reason.description: skip: why the case is excluded; it is reported as Not Run, never as passed.

approved_scope_digest.description: The approved test-case scope the results were recorded against (scripts/lib/execution-ledger.js approvedScopeDigest).

outcome.description: As the operator reports it. A pass needs evidence; a missing result is not a result (the case stays Not Run).

executed_at.description: When the work was actually done, as supplied.

operator.description: Who performed it, as supplied. This is not a reviewer's approval.
